title: •Commander Luke Skywalker
caption: •Commander Luke Skywalker (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. While piloting Rogue 1, it is maneuver +2 and Luke draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During your control phase, may ▲ a speeder or a card with “T-47” in game text. Immune to attrition < 3.
lore: Hero of Yavin. Promoted to Commander in his third year of military training with the Alliance. Squadron flight *leader* at Echo Base during the Battle of Hoth.
